cues.text: A 38-year-old woman falls from her horse at low speed.
She suffers a twisting injury, and feels pain in the region of the fracture.
Radiographs show a fracture of the humeral diaphysis, the shaft of the humerus.
On the same side, she has a wrist drop: she cannot lift her hand.
The radial nerve runs in the spiral groove of the humerus.
So it is vulnerable when the humeral shaft breaks.
Radial nerve injury causes her wrist drop.
